research_rules.source_priority: Check the current exact-model mainland manufacturer or seller page first, then a directly attributable marketplace listing if needed.
research_rules.price_acceptance: Add a mainland observed-price record only when an exact model and CNY listing/checkout amount are directly visible. Official MSRP alone does not close an observed-checkout gap.
research_rules.purchase_route_acceptance: Record only the exact variant route and directly visible current listing or inquiry status. Do not infer SKU selection, mainland stock, warranty, delivery, payment or checkout from a generic manufacturer page or overseas listing.
research_rules.recording: Add dated source provenance and a field-specific dated attempt for each target. Update displayed route or price only when directly supported; retain unknown or promotion-conditional states with a concrete reason otherwise.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Process five exact targets sequentially. Stop at decisive exact evidence or one concrete access, identity or option limitation; do not restart exhaustive channel sweeps or bypass login/challenge gates.
